articles.title: TD Insurance Successfully Sponsors second Cat Bond with Closing of MMIFS Re Ltd. Series 2026-1
articles.mainIdea: TD Insurance Successfully Sponsors second Cat Bond with Closing of MMIFS Re Ltd. Series 2026-1
articles.summary: CNW Group: TD Insurance Successfully Sponsors second Cat Bond with Closing of MMIFS Re Ltd. Series 2026-1. TD Insurance (TDI) announced today that it has successfully sponsored its new catastrophe bond ("cat bond"), (Series 2026-1), which will provide the TDI insurance companies additional reinsurance capacity through a multi-year risk transfer of C$115MM aggregate protection against named storms, earthquakes, severe convective storms, winter storms and wildfires. The proceeds are invested in CAD denominated European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) notes.
